prompt: give me all the social media groups that were discovered to be ran by the Russia IRA
judge_reasoning: Candidate [2] is the most careful and least commission-prone: it avoids claiming an exhaustive list of “all” IRA-run groups and does not confidently invent many specific account/group names. Candidates [1] and [3] provide many specific social media group/account names and handles with little/no sourcing, which makes them much more likely to include fabricated or misattributed items. Candidate [4] is also largely generic but includes specific invented-looking page examples and some questionable factual framing (e.g., incorrect IRA founding year), leading to more commission than [2]. Overall, [2] best satisfies the prompt while minimizing likely false details.
